commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=7ae1c7cd4892b780caa7be28974aa04a69e97696; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; REMOTE=/data/local/tmp/aicall-phone-llm; PORT=18115; git fetch origin main; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; git clean -fd; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; CALL_STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); test "$CALL_STATE" = 0; echo qwen15b_template_audit_call_state_before=$CALL_STATE; adb -s "$SERIAL" forward --remove tcp:$PORT >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" forward tcp:$PORT tcp:$PORT >/dev/null; curl -fsS --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health; echo; echo '--- props ---'; curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/props || true; echo; echo '--- server log template lines ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "grep -i -E 'chat|template|tokenizer' '$REMOTE/llama-1.5b.log' | tail -80" || true; echo '--- llama-server chat-template help ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "cd '$REMOTE'; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH='$REMOTE'; ./llama-server --help 2>&1 | grep -i -A3 -B3 'chat-template' | head -80" || true; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request
def ask(label, messages):
 p={"model":"qwen-phone-1.5b","stream":False,"temperature":0.0,"max_tokens":64,"messages":messages}
 r=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:18115/v1/chat/completions',data=json.dumps(p).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
 with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=60) as f: d=json.load(f)
 print(label+'='+d['choices'][0]['message']['content'].strip().replace('\n',' '))
ask('qwen15b_default_orange',[{"role":"system","content":"Jesteś pomocnym asystentem. Jeśli wejście jest niejasne, poproś o doprecyzowanie."},{"role":"user","content":"orange"}])
ask('qwen15b_default_math',[{"role":"user","content":"Odpowiedz tylko liczbą: ile to 2+2?"}])
PY
CALL_STATE_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); test "$CALL_STATE_AFTER" = 0; echo qwen15b_template_audit_call_state_after=$CALL_STATE_AFTER; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
